subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The council president is known __to play devil’s advocate__ often.

options.text: To argue, just for the sake of it

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"play devil’s advocate"** means to pretend to be against an idea or plan that one actually supports in order to provoke discussion or argument. (वाद-विवाद के लिए विरोधी भूमिका निभाना)

 
 
• **Example: **During the meeting, Jenna decided to play devil's advocate to ensure all sides of the argument were explored.
 
 

 
• **"To argue, just for the sake of it" **captures the essence of playing devil’s advocate, as it involves taking a position one might not necessarily agree with, simply to foster discussion or debate. (केवल चर्चा या बहस को बढ़ावा देने के लिए विरोधी तर्क देना)

 
 
• **Example: **He often plays devil's advocate in discussions, not because he disagrees, but to ensure a thorough examination of the topic.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the phrase **'play devil’s advocate'** is most appropriately defined by **'Option 3'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To allow others to rise** (दूसरों को आगे बढ़ने की अनुमति देना): This means providing opportunities or support to help others succeed.
 
 
• **Example:** She always believed in playing a supportive role to allow others to rise in their careers.
 
 

 
• **To play risky games** (जोखिम भरे खेल खेलना): Engaging in activities that involve high risk.
 
 
• **Example: **Investing all your money in one stock is like playing risky games with your financial future.
 
 

 
• **Make one’s own destiny** (अपनी किस्मत खुद बनाना): To be in control of one’s future through one's actions.
 
 
• **Example:** He believed that hard work was the way to make one's own destiny.
